Workflow

Clear from brief to delivery.

A simple four-step process keeps the creative direction aligned and the project moving.

1

Brief

Understand the goals, audience, references, platform, and delivery requirements.

2

Editing

Shape pacing, captions, sound design, supporting visuals, and motion graphics.

3

Feedback

Review feedback carefully and make the revisions agreed for the project.

4

Delivery

Export and deliver the finalized video in the required format and aspect ratio.

About me

Editing with purpose, not noise.

I'm Muhammad Faiq, a video editor specializing in short-form content. I focus on engaging storytelling, clean editing, sharp pacing, and motion graphics that make the message easier to follow and harder to scroll past.

My workflow combines Adobe Premiere Pro for precise editorial work with Adobe After Effects for animated captions, typography, and visual polish.
